query: What pre-trend diagnostics, visualizations, and formal placebo tests best validate parallel trends for district-level event studies?

response.query: What pre-trend diagnostics, visualizations, and formal placebo tests best validate parallel trends for district-level event studies?
response.answer: To validate parallel trends in district-level event studies, use pre-trend diagnostics like visual inspection of outcome trajectories, formal placebo tests, and statistical tests such as the Hansen test for pre-treatment trends.

results.title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs: Hospital Outpatient ...
results.content: + (2) CY 2026 ASC Special Payment Policy Proposal for OPPS Complexity-Adjusted C-APCs. Proposed Low Volume APCs and Limit on ASC Payment Rates for Procedures Assigned to Low Volume APCs. Proposed Payment for Covered Ancillary Services. Proposed Removal of the Hospital Commitment to Health Equity (HCHE) Measure From the Hospital OQR and REHQR Programs and the Facility Commitment to Health Equity (FCHE) Measure From the ASCQR Program Beginning With the CY 2025 Reporting Period/CY 2027 Payment or Program Determination. Updated Hospital Price Transparency Guidance Implementing the President's Executive Order “Making America Healthy Again by Empowering Patients with Clear, Accurate, and Actionable Healthcare Pricing Information,” May 22, 2025, *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​updated-hpt-guidance-encoding-allowed-amounts.pdf.*. of this proposed rule, if CMS does not finalize to amend 45 CFR 180.50(b)(2)(ii)(C)(2)(ii)(C)), hospitals would use the “estimated allowed amount” as required under the current hospital price transparency regulations for purposes of calculating the median payer-specific negotiated charge that is reported on the cost report.

results.title: Federal Register :: Medicare Program: Hospital Outpatient ...
results.content: Adoption of New Measures for the Hospital OQR Program Measure Set. Adoption of the COVID-19 Vaccination Coverage Among Health Care Personnel (HCP) Measure Beginning With the CY 2022 Reporting Period/CY 2024 Payment Determination. Requiring OP-37a-e: Outpatient and Ambulatory Surgery Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (OAS CAHPS) Survey-Based Measures Beginning With Voluntary Reporting for the CY 2023 Reporting Period and Mandatory Reporting Beginning With the CY 2024 Reporting Period/CY 2026 Payment Determination and for Subsequent Years. Data Submission Requirements for the OP-37a-e: Outpatient and Ambulatory Surgery Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (OAS CAHPS) Survey-Based Measures for the CY 2024 Reporting Period/CY 2026 Payment Determination and Subsequent Years. Retrieved from: *https://www.cms.gov/​newsroom/​fact-sheets/​cy-2021-medicare-hospital-outpatient-prospective-payment-system-and-ambulatory-surgical-center*. As stated in section XVI.B.4.c. of the CY 2022 OPPS/ASC proposed rule, “we note that the two modes (web with mail follow-up of non-respondents; and web with telephone follow-up of non-respondents) will be available beginning in CY 2022 for National OAS CAHPS voluntary reporting, and then if finalized, available as part of ASCQR Program beginning in the CY 2023 reporting period and subsequent years”.
